scientific_integrity: The general claim rests on an analytic classification of all polar vertices, strict screening of all nonzero minority-cluster levels, concave integer optimization and rank of contact normals. Independent external mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Canonical coordinate Euclidean norm, two internally equilateral clusters with \(2\le p\le q\), \(0<s,t<1\), cross distance 1 only; nonuniform multi-cluster and Banach-Mazur-optimized norms are not treated. Historical priority under Lipschitz variance terminology remains a possibility. Finite computations do not establish continuous-parameter claims.
title: Majority-cluster screening and incenter collapse in two-cluster ultrametric free spaces
